* '''PC-E2''' ([[Geonosis: Separatist Council Room (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 18 February 2014 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual9-Dark">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/</code>, every card image dated 18 February 2014: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034808/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. While two senators here, they may use their game text as if in a senate majority. / While Gunray or opponent's senator here, your spies may not deploy here.” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). * '''PC-E3''' ([[Geonosis: Separatist Council Room (Errata 3)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 9 July 2014, effective immediately (removed text struck through)<ref name="forum-p890420">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 9 July 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p890420 p890420] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: Dark Side “May ▼ Gunray. While two senators here, they use their game text as if in a senate majority.” Light Side unchanged. '''What changed:''' “may” is struck from “they may use their game text”, so that senators with non-optional continuous effects work as designed. (The Holotable data of October 2014 has a third wording, “they are in a senate majority”; data files are dating evidence only.)
